-- ==============================================================================
-- GLOBAL SCRIPT (GS) v54 - ANTI-BAN & CLONE REMOVER EDITION (ALL EXECUTORS)
-- ==============================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- ===== OBTENCIÓN SEGURA DE LOCALPLAYER =====
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
while not LP do
	task.wait()
	LP = Players.LocalPlayer
end
local Mouse = LP:GetMouse()

-- ==============================================================================
-- 🛡️ MOTOR ANTI-BAN & ANTI-KICK UNIVERSAL (BYPASS FE)
-- ==============================================================================
local antiKickActive = true
pcall(function()
	if typeof(hookmetamethod) == "function" and typeof(newcclosure) == "function" then
		local oldNamecall
		oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
			local method = getnamecallmethod()
			local args = {...}

			if not checkcaller() and antiKickActive then
				local mLower = tostring(method):lower()
				
				if mLower == "kick" and (self == LP or self == Players or self == game) then
					warn("[GS ANTI-BAN] Intento de Kick bloqueado con éxito:", tostring(args[1]))
					return nil
				end

				if mLower == "fireserver" or mLower == "invokeserver" then
					local rName = tostring(self.Name):lower()
					if rName:find("ban") or rName:find("kick") or rName:find("detect") or rName:find("cheat") 
					or rName:find("exploit") or rName:find("flag") or rName:find("report") or rName:find("anticheat") 
					or rName:find("security") or rName:find("telemetry") then
						warn("[GS ANTI-BAN] Envío de reporte de cheat bloqueado a:", self.Name)
						return nil
					end
				end
			end
			return oldNamecall(self, ...)
		end))

		local oldIndex
		oldIndex = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, key)
			if not checkcaller() and antiKickActive and (self == LP or self == Players) and tostring(key):lower() == "kick" then
				return newcclosure(function(...)
					warn("[GS ANTI-BAN] Intento de Kick por Index bloqueado.")
					return nil
				end)
			end
			return oldIndex(self, key)
		end))
	end
end)

-- ===== PARENT GUI ANTI-CRASH =====
local function getSafeParent()
	local parent = nil
	if type(gethui) == "function" then
		pcall(function() parent = gethui() end)
	end
	if not parent then
		pcall(function() parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
	end
	if not parent or not pcall(function() return parent.Name end) then
		parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	end
	return parent
end

local guiParent = getSafeParent()

-- Limpieza de versiones previas

	if guiParent:FindFirstChild("GS_V54") then guiParent.GS_V54:Destroy() end
	if LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("GS_V54") then LP.PlayerGui.GS_V54:Destroy() end

end)

-- Variables de Personaje y Revive
local Character = LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local RootPart = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local realSpawnCFrame = RootPart and RootPart.CFrame or nil
local lastSafeCFrame = RootPart and RootPart.CFrame or nil

-- Coordenadas y Estados
local lastAliveCFrame = RootPart and RootPart.CFrame or nil
local autoReviveInSitu = true
local autoRemoteRevive = false
local preventDeathFE = false
local autoStandUp = true
local isDeadState = false
local autoFarmBABFT = false

-- Duplicador y Rastreador de Clones
local copiedObject = nil
local clickToDupe = false
local clickToDelete = false
local customObjectName = ""
local spawnedClones = {}

-- Multiplicador de Daño
local damageBoost = false
local damageMultiplier = 3
local fastFireRate = false
local isProcessingHit = false

-- Pegado a la Cabeza (Sticky Head)
local stickyHead = false
local stickyOffset = 1.8

-- 1ra Persona Lock
local firstPersonLock = false

-- ==============================================================================
-- MOTOR DE MULTIPLICACIÓN DE DAÑO Y CADENCIA
-- ==============================================================================
local function getEquippedTool()
	return Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
end

local function applyDamageBoostToTool(tool)
	if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
	pcall(function()
		for _, v in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
			if v:IsA("NumberValue") or v:IsA("IntValue") or v:IsA("DoubleConstrainedValue") then
				local n = string.lower(v.Name)
				if n:find("damage") or n:find("dmg") or n:find("power") or n:find("headshot") or n:find("hit") then
					if not v:FindFirstChild("GS_OrigDmg") then
						local orig = Instance.new("NumberValue", v)
						orig.Name = "GS_OrigDmg"
						orig.Value = v.Value
					end
					local baseVal = v:FindFirstChild("GS_OrigDmg") and v.GS_OrigDmg.Value or v.Value
					v.Value = baseVal * damageMultiplier
				elseif fastFireRate and (n:find("cooldown") or n:find("firerate") or n:find("delay") or n:find("wait") or n:find("reload")) then
					v.Value = 0.01
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function executeMultiHit(tool)
	if not damageBoost or isProcessingHit or not tool or tool.Parent ~= Character then return end
	isProcessingHit = true

	applyDamageBoostToTool(tool)

	task.spawn(function()
		local extraHits = math.clamp(damageMultiplier - 1, 1, 8)
		for i = 1, extraHits do
			if not damageBoost or not tool or tool.Parent ~= Character then break end
			task.wait(0.03)
			pcall(function()
				tool:Activate()
				
				local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
				if handle and typeof(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
					for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
							local targetHrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
							if targetHrp and RootPart and (targetHrp.Position - RootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 20 then
								firetouchinterest(handle, targetHrp, 0)
								task.wait(0.005)
								firetouchinterest(handle, targetHrp, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		isProcessingHit = false
	end)
end

local function hookToolActivation(tool)
	if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		if damageBoost then
			executeMultiHit(tool)
		end
	end)
end

-- ==============================================================================
-- 🧬 MOTOR DE DUPLICACIÓN & ELIMINACIÓN DE CLONES
-- ==============================================================================
local function forceArchivable(obj)
	if not obj then return end
	pcall(function()
		obj.Archivable = true
		for _, descendant in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
			descendant.Archivable = true
		end
	end)
end

local function registerClone(clone)
	if not clone then return end
	pcall(function()
		clone:SetAttribute("GS_ClonedObject", true)
	end)
	table.insert(spawnedClones, clone)
end

local function smartClone(instance)
	if not instance then return nil end
	forceArchivable(instance)
	local ok, clone = pcall(function()
		return instance:Clone()
	end)
	if ok and clone then
		registerClone(clone)
		return clone
	end
	return nil
end

local function duplicateWorkspaceObject(objeto, heightOffset)
	if not objeto or not objeto:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
	heightOffset = heightOffset or Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	
	local copia = smartClone(objeto)
	if copia then
		copia.Parent = workspace
		pcall(function()
			if copia:IsA("BasePart") then
				copia.CFrame = objeto.CFrame + heightOffset
			elseif copia:IsA("Model") then
				copia:PivotTo(objeto:GetPivot() + heightOffset)
			elseif copia:IsA("Tool") then
				local handle = copia:FindFirstChild("Handle") or copia:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
				if handle then
					handle.CFrame = handle.CFrame + heightOffset
				end
			end
		end)
		return true, copia.Name
	end
	return false, nil
end

-- Funciones de Eliminación de Clones
local function clearAllClones()
	local count = 0
	for i = #spawnedClones, 1, -1 do
		local obj = spawnedClones[i]
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
			count = count + 1
		end
		table.remove(spawnedClones, i)
	end
	
	-- Escaneo adicional de respaldo en workspace
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:GetAttribute("GS_ClonedObject") then
			pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
			count = count + 1
		end
	end
	notify("🧹 Se eliminaron " .. count .. " objetos clonados.", THEME.warning, 3)
end

local function deleteLastClone()
	while #spawnedClones > 0 do
		local obj = table.remove(spawnedClones)
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			local name = obj.Name
			pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
			notify("↩️ Último clon '" .. name .. "' eliminado.", THEME.warning, 2)
			return
		end
	end
	notify("No hay clones recientes para eliminar.", THEME.danger, 2)
end

local function deleteTargetUnderMouse()
	local target = Mouse.Target
	if target and not target:IsDescendantOf(Character) and target ~= workspace then
		local obj = target.Parent:IsA("Model") and target.Parent ~= workspace and not target.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and target.Parent or target
		local name = obj.Name
		pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
		notify("🗑️ Objeto '" .. name .. "' eliminado del mapa.", THEME.warning, 2.5)
	else
		notify("Apunta con el ratón a un objeto válido.", THEME.warning, 2)
	end
end

local function setFirstPerson(enable)
	firstPersonLock = enable
	pcall(function()
		if enable then
			LP.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
			LP.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
			LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 0.5

end

-- ==============================================================================
-- FUNCIÓN DE REVIVIR
-- ==============================================================================
local function revivePlayer(character)
	if not character then character = LP.Character end
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
		humanoid.JumpPower = 50
		pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
	end
end

-- ===== SISTEMA DE KEYBINDS =====
local menuKey = Enum.KeyCode.Q
local menuKeyName = "Q"
local waitingForMenuKey = false
local hackKeybinds = {}
local waitingForHackKey = nil
local NONE_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown

local function registerKeybind(name, defKey, defName, func)
	hackKeybinds[name] = {
		key = defKey,
		keyName = defName,
		toggleFunc = func,
		default = {key = defKey, keyName = defName}
	}
end

local function resetAllKeybinds()
	menuKey = Enum.KeyCode.Q
	menuKeyName = "Q"
	for _, b in pairs(hackKeybinds) do
		b.key = NONE_KEY
		b.keyName = "Ninguno"
	end
end

-- ===== INVISIBILIDAD GLOBAL (FE) =====
local feInvisible = false
local originalMotorC0s = {}

local function setFEInvisibility(enable)
	feInvisible = enable
	local char = LP.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if enable then
		originalMotorC0s = {}
		for _, m in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Name ~= "RootJoint" then
				originalMotorC0s[m] = m.C0
				m.C0 = m.C0 * CFrame.new(0, -99999, 0)
			end
		end
		if hrp then
			hrp.Transparency = 0.5
			hrp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
			hrp.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
		end
	else
		for m, c0 in pairs(originalMotorC0s) do
			if m and m.Parent then
				pcall(function() m.C0 = c0 end)
			end
		end
		originalMotorC0s = {}
		if hrp then hrp.Transparency = 1 end
	end
end

-- ===== FE GODMODE =====
local function applyFEGodmode()
	pcall(function()
		local char = LP.Character
		if not char then return end
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end

		local newHum = hum:Clone()
		newHum.Parent = char
		newHum.MaxHealth = hum.MaxHealth
		newHum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
		hum:Destroy()

		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = newHum
		Character = char
		Humanoid = newHum
		newHum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
		pcall(function() newHum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false) end)
	end)
end

-- MANEJADOR DE RESPAWN
local function updateChar(char)
	Character = char
	Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	RootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if not realSpawnCFrame and RootPart then realSpawnCFrame = RootPart.CFrame end
	isDeadState = false

	revivePlayer(char)

	char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Tool") then
			hookToolActivation(child)
			applyDamageBoostToTool(child)
		end
	end)

	for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Tool") then
			hookToolActivation(child)
			applyDamageBoostToTool(child)
		end
	end

	if autoReviveInSitu and lastAliveCFrame and RootPart then
		task.spawn(function()
			task.wait(0.05)
			for i = 1, 6 do
				if RootPart then
					RootPart.CFrame = lastAliveCFrame
					RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				task.wait(0.04)
			end
		end)
	end

	if feInvisible then
		task.wait(0.6)
		setFEInvisibility(true)
	end

	if preventDeathFE then
		task.wait(0.5)
		applyFEGodmode()
	end

	if firstPersonLock then
		setFirstPerson(true)
	end
end
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(updateChar)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	pcall(function()
		if Character and RootPart and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
			lastAliveCFrame = RootPart.CFrame
		end

		if autoStandUp and Humanoid and Character then
			local state = Humanoid:GetState()
			if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
				pcall(function()
					Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
					Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
					Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
					Humanoid.Sit = false
					Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
				end)
			end
		end
	end)
end)

-- BUCLE AUTO-REVIVE
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		pcall(function()
			local char = LP.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local deadNow = false

			if hum then
				deadNow = (hum.Health <= 0)
			elseif char then
				deadNow = (char:FindFirstChild("Head") == nil and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") == nil)
			else
				deadNow = true
			end

			if deadNow and not isDeadState then
				isDeadState = true
				revivePlayer(char)

				local pGui = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
				if pGui then
					for _, b in ipairs(pGui:GetDescendants()) do
						if b:IsA("TextButton") or b:IsA("ImageButton") then
							local n = string.lower(b.Name)
							local txt = b:IsA("TextButton") and string.lower(b.Text) or ""
							if n:find("respawn") or n:find("revive") or n:find("play") or txt:find("respawn") or txt:find("revive") or txt:find("spawn") then
								pcall(function() b:Activate() end)
							end
						end
					end
				end

				task.wait(0.5)
				pcall(function() LP:LoadCharacter() end)
			end
		end)
		task.wait(0.4)
	end
end)

-- ===== RESOLVER DE OBJETIVOS UNIVERSAL =====
local function getPlayerCharacter(plr)
	if not plr then return nil end
	if plr.Character and plr.Character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return plr.Character end
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Model") and (obj.Name == plr.Name or obj.Name == plr.DisplayName) then
			if obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or obj:FindFirstChild("Head") then
				return obj
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function getPlayerRoot(plr)
	if not plr then return nil end
	local char = getPlayerCharacter(plr)
	if not char then return nil end
	return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
		or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
end

	color = color or THEME.accent

local function isAlive(char)
	if not char then return false end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then return hum.Health > 0 end
	return char:FindFirstChild("Head") ~= nil
end

local function findPart(char, pref)
	if not char then return nil end
	for _, n in ipairs({pref, "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "Torso"}) do
		local p = char:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
	end
	return char:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
end

local function canSeeTarget(part)
	if not aimWallCheck then return true end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam or not part then return true end
	local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
	local dir = part.Position - origin
	if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then return true end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {Character, cam}
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.IgnoreWater = true
	local res = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
	if not res then return true end
	return res.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function getAimbotTarget()
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return nil end
	local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

	if aimTargetPlayer then
		if aimTargetPlayer.Parent ~= Players then
			aimTargetPlayer = nil
			return nil
		end
		local char = getPlayerCharacter(aimTargetPlayer)
		if char and isAlive(char) then
			local part = findPart(char, aimPart)
			if part then
				local sp, vis = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
				if vis and sp.Z > 0 and canSeeTarget(part) then return part end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local bestPart, bestDist = nil, aimFOVRadius
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LP and plr.Character and not (aimTeamCheck and plr.Team and LP.Team and plr.Team == LP.Team) then
			local char = getPlayerCharacter(plr)
			if char and isAlive(char) then
				local part = findPart(char, aimPart)
				if part then
					local sp, vis = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
					if vis and sp.Z > 0 then
						local dist2D = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
						if dist2D < bestDist and canSeeTarget(part) then
							bestDist = dist2D
							bestPart = part
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPart
end

RunService:BindToRenderStep("GS_AimbotV54", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
	if not aimOn then return end
	if aimOnlyOnRightClick and not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) and not isMobile then return end

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end

	local targetPart = getAimbotTarget()
	if not targetPart then return end

	local targetPos = targetPart.Position
	if aimPrediction > 0 then
		local model = targetPart.Parent
		local hrp = model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
		if hrp then
			local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			if vel and vel == vel and vel.Magnitude > 1 then
				targetPos = targetPos + vel * ((targetPos - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude / 800) * aimPrediction
			end
		end
	end

	local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPos)
	if not onScreen or screenPos.Z <= 0 then return end

	local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
	local offset = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center
	local speedFactor = math.clamp((11 - aimSmooth) / 10, 0.1, 1)

	local moved = false
	if typeof(mousemoverel) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			mousemoverel(offset.X * speedFactor, offset.Y * speedFactor)
			moved = true
		end)
	end
	if not moved then
		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
		local dir = targetPos - camPos
		if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 and dir == dir then
			cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(camPos, targetPos), math.clamp(speedFactor * dt * 35, 0.05, 1))
		end
	end
end)

local function toggleFreecam(enable)
	freecamOn = enable
	local Cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not Cam then return end
	if enable then
		Cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		local look = Cam.CFrame.LookVector
		freecamRotX = math.asin(look.Y)
		freecamRotY = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
		freecamConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not freecamOn then return end
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera then return end
			local mv = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
			if UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) or isMobile then
				local d = UIS:GetMouseDelta()
				freecamRotY = freecamRotY - d.X * 0.004
				freecamRotX = math.clamp(freecamRotX - d.Y * 0.004, -1.4, 1.4)
			end
			local rot = CFrame.Angles(0, freecamRotY, 0) * CFrame.Angles(freecamRotX, 0, 0)
			camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position) * rot + rot:VectorToWorldSpace(mv) * freecamSpeed
		end)
	else
		if freecamConn then freecamConn:Disconnect(); freecamConn = nil end
		Cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		local hum = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then Cam.CameraSubject = hum end
	end
end

    local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not Root or not Humanoid then return end
    
    isFlinging = true
    FlingButton.Text = "[ ACTIVE... ]"
    FlingButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 69, 0)
    
    local rightVector = Root.CFrame.RightVector
    local lookVector = Root.CFrame.LookVector

    Humanoid.JumpPower = 70

            FlingButton.Text = "⚡ CCICCX FLING"
            FlingButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 144, 255)

-- =============================================
local function createButton(name, position, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 45)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, position)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
    button.BorderSizePixel = 2
    button.Text = name
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
    button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    button.TextSize = 13
    button.Parent = scrollFrame
    
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    
    -- Hover effect
    button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    end)
    button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    end)
    
    return button
end

-- =============================================
-- FLYING SYSTEM
-- =============================================
local function startFly()
    if flying then return end
    flying = true
    
    velocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    velocity.Parent = rootPart
    print("✈️ Fly Started")
end

local function stopFly()
    if not flying then return end
    flying = false
    if velocity and velocity.Parent then
        velocity:Destroy()
        velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    end
    print("❌ Fly Stopped")
end

-- =============================================
-- NOCLIP SYSTEM
-- =============================================
local function applyNoclip(state)
    if not character then return end
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = not state
        end
    end
end

-- =============================================
-- MAIN LOOP
-- =============================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not character or not character.Parent then return end
    
    -- ===== FLY =====
    if scripts.fly and flying then
        local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            velocity.Velocity = moveDir.Unit * config.flySpeed
        end
    elseif scripts.fly and not flying then
        startFly()
    end
    
    -- ===== NOCLIP =====
    if scripts.noclip then
        applyNoclip(true)
    else
        applyNoclip(false)
    end
    
    -- ===== POV CAMERA =====
    if scripts.povCamera then
        local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head then
            cameraTime = cameraTime + 0.016
            
            local moveSpeed = humanoid.MoveVector.Magnitude
            local bob = 0
            if moveSpeed > 0 then
                bob = math.sin(cameraTime * 5) * config.cameraBob * moveSpeed
            end
            
            local headCFrame = head.CFrame
            local cameraOffset = CFrame.new(0, config.cameraOffsetY + bob, config.cameraOffsetZ)
            
            Camera.CFrame = headCFrame * cameraOffset
            Camera.FieldOfView = config.cameraFOV
        end
    end
    
    -- ===== FOLLOW PLAYER =====
    if scripts.followPlayer and selectedTarget and selectedTarget.Character then
        local targetRoot = selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            rootPart.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 0, -5)
        end
    end
    
    -- ===== FLING =====
    if scripts.fling then
        local mouseTarget = player:GetMouse().Target
        if mouseTarget and mouseTarget.Parent then
            local targetChar = Players:FindFirstChild(mouseTarget.Parent.Name)
            if targetChar and targetChar.Character then
                local targetRoot = targetChar.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if targetRoot then
                    targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Unit * config.flingPower
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- ===== SHOW FPS =====
    if scripts.showFps then
        local fps = math.round(1 / RunService.RenderStepped:Wait())
        fpsLabel.Text = "🟨 FPS: " .. fps
        fpsLabel.Visible = true
    else
        fpsLabel.Visible = false
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F then
        scripts.fly = not scripts.fly
        if scripts.fly then startFly() else stopFly() end
    end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
        scripts.povCamera = not scripts.povCamera
    end
end)
